cron.description: Búsqueda diaria de nuevos leads a las 02:00

redesign._model_comment: Modelo Magnific por defecto para images_generate (mode/resolution/quality). Catálogo y coste por imagen en magnific_models.json. "auto" deja elegir a Magnific.

style_presets.name: Editorial Premium
style_presets.prompt: premium editorial, modern serif typography, generous white space, restrained palette with a single accent colour

style_presets.name: Swiss / Internacional
style_presets.prompt: swiss design, strict grid, Helvetica, red/black/white, asymmetric composition

style_presets.name: Dark Data Viz
style_presets.prompt: dark background, luminous data visualization, subtle neon accents, premium dashboard feel

style_presets.name: Brutalist
style_presets.prompt: brutalism, oversized typography, hard edges, high contrast, no shadows

style_presets.name: Consultoría Corporativa
style_presets.prompt: tier-1 consultancy report in the McKinsey/BCG mould, navy and grey, clean charts with clear labels, headline hierarchy with a kicker, high but orderly data density

style_presets.name: Memoria Anual
style_presets.prompt: corporate annual report, full-bleed cover image, headline figures set large, two-column grid, cream paper, understated elegance

style_presets.name: Infografía Visual
style_presets.prompt: infographic style, consistent line iconography, flow diagrams and data maps, three-colour palette, text pared back to the essentials

style_presets.name: Científico / Académico
style_presets.prompt: scientific rigour, precise tables and charts with footnotes, serif typography for long reading, numbered figures, neutral palette with a cool accent

style_presets.name: Revista / Feature
style_presets.prompt: magazine layout, dramatic typographic headline, drop-cap standfirst, text columns with images wrapped around them, strong contrast of scale

style_presets.name: Sostenibilidad / ESG
style_presets.prompt: ESG report, natural greens and earth tones, organic iconography, integrated nature photography, impact indicators given prominence

style_presets.name: Fintech / Financiero
style_presets.prompt: modern financial report, crisp data tables, time-series charts, deep blue and mint green, geometric sans typography, generous breathing room

style_presets.name: Tech / Producto
style_presets.prompt: tech product style, subtle gradients, rounded cards, modern sans typography, integrated interface screenshots, startup deck feel

style_presets.name: Minimal Monocromo
style_presets.prompt: strict monochrome, black and white, a single type weight varying only in scale, hairlines as the only ornament, visual silence

style_presets.name: Institucional / Policy
style_presets.prompt: public policy institutional document, formal restraint, institutional blue, prominent executive summary, recommendation boxes, numbered hierarchy

scoring._comment: Sectores con encaje comercial: suman 12 puntos al score. Edítalos a tu criterio.

radar._comment: Un lead entra en el radar cuando su último informe cumple cycle_months ± window_months.

branding.footer: Think Things — estudio de diseño gráfico, Barcelona
branding.footer_en: Think Things — graphic design studio, Barcelona
branding.note_en: The data is 100% yours — only the design has changed.
branding._comment: Identidad del PDF comparativo. logo_white: versión del logo para la banda turquesa (vacío = no se dibuja). font_regular/font_bold: rutas a .ttf/.otf/.ttc; vacío = Avenir del sistema y, si no está, Helvetica.

budget._comment: Topes de créditos Magnific. La generación pide confirmación al superarlos. El coste estimado sale de magnific_models.json (simulate_cost), no de una media fija.

jobs._comment: Trabajos largos (generación) simultáneos. Cada uno gasta créditos: súbelo con cuidado.
